ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-3,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 19-H
in the area bounded by:

a line 132 feet south and parallel to West Howard Street; North Ashland Avenue; North
Rogers Avenue; the northeast right-of-way line of the Chicago North Shore and
Milwaukee Railroad; the alley next east of and parallel to North Ashland Avenue,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Webel,

Maria E. Hadden
Alderman, 49" Ward

Common Addresses:
7500-7530 N. Ashland Avenue
